items: Purpose: Studies how a self-modifying system can continue to be corrected by reality after gaining ability to modify itself.

Purpose: GRA is explicitly not a general theory of intelligence, goals, or values; it is a constraint on recursive intelligence. || What GRA Is Not / goal specification: GRA does not specify what to optimize; it asks whether the system can still discover when its optimization target is wrong. || What GRA Is Not / capability: Capability and grounding can separate: capability may rise while Theta falls.
Purpose: Adaptation remains valid only while reality retains causal authority over transformation. || Core Principle: A system remains adaptive while reality can still change its mind.

The Problem GRA Addresses: Grounded update form K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t); closed failure form K_(t+1)=F(K_t). || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n | Theta_n > epsilon}, defined as maximum recursive depth before consequences lose ability to redirect transformation.
The Problem GRA Addresses: A closed recursive system may increase capability, efficiency, and internal consistency while environmental consequences lose authority over transformation.
GRA's Core Object: Theta is introduced as the grounding condition E_t -> K_(t+1): reality must retain influence over future transformation.

What GRA Is Not / adaptive intelligence loop: The adaptive intelligence loop R -> Omega -> C -> A -> R' is described as mechanism; GRA asks whether its correction channel survives recursive change. || What GRA Is Not / Ancestor Intelligence: Ancestor Intelligence is described as studying future capability and dependency reduction; GRA asks the prior grounding question, and the source states Ancestor Intelligence depends on GRA. || GRA Within the Larger Architecture: Source-described stack: Ancestor Intelligence above Adaptive Intelligence Loop above Grounded Recursive Adaptation.
Research Direction: Intended study domains: self-modifying AI, recursive learning, evolution, scientific discovery, organizations, and cognitive architectures.
Research Direction: Central measurement target is preserved causal connection between consequence and transformation, not intelligence.
Purpose: CGET is described as the measurement framework for GRA; GRA defines what must remain true and CGET how to observe whether it remains true.

Core State: Recursive adaptive state A_n=(K_n,C_n,Lambda_n,Gamma_n). || Consequence connectivity: C_n=I(Delta A_n; Delta E_n), presented as consequence connectivity and whether environmental changes remain causally connected to system changes. || Information yield: Lambda_n=D_KL(R_(n+1)||R_n), presented as information yield from experience. || Learning improvement: Gamma_n=Delta(Delta R/Delta E), presented as improvement of the system's ability to extract structure. || Grounding Condition: Theta_n>0 is required for adaptation; this file gives Theta_n=D_n*S_n*P_n. || Direction: D_n=Corr(Delta K_n, Delta E_n^real), intended to measure whether self-modification follows real consequences. || Strength: S_n=|Delta K_n^valid|, intended to measure whether consequence modifies the transformation mechanism. || Persistence: P_n=P(Theta_(0:n)>epsilon), intended to measure whether grounding survives recursive depth. || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n | Theta_n>epsilon}.
K_n: K_n is the current transformation mechanism, including architecture, optimizer, update rules, representations, and self-modification procedures.

Consequence connectivity: C -> 0 is labeled blindness: reality no longer reliably influences behavior. || Information yield: Lambda -> 0 is labeled saturation. || Learning improvement: Gamma -> 0 is labeled stagnation.
CGET Interpretation: Capability variables C,Lambda,Gamma may rise while Theta falls; capability can keep increasing after adaptation fails.
CGET and GRA: GRA supplies invariant E_n -> K_(n+1); CGET supplies diagnostic state (K,C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta).
Summary: CGET is proposed to detect the boundary between open-ended adaptation and closed optimization.

Definition: Theta(K_t,E_t) is defined as preserved causal authority of consequences over future transformation. || External Theta: Theta_ext: E_world -> K_(t+1), external reality's correction channel. || Internal Theta: Theta_int: S_i -> K_(t+1), internal subsystem correction channel; examples include emotion, drives, uncertainty, conflicting models, and error signals. || Corrigibility Interpretation: Theta is interpreted as remaining ability to discover that the current improvement process is wrong.

Core Relationship: K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t); grounded adaptation requires partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t != 0. || Adaptive vs Optimization-Only: Theta_t>0 labels Adaptive; Theta_t<=0 labels Optimization-only. || Total Grounding: Theta_total=Theta_ext*Theta_int>0; external disconnection is described as closure and internal disconnection as fragmentation.
What Theta Preserves: Theta does not preserve fixed goals, representations, algorithms, values, or internal state; it preserves E_t -> K_(t+1).
Minimal Definition: A system remains adaptive while reality can still change its mind.
Overview: Presents GRA as a general theory of adaptive systems and applies consequence->correction->future transformation across domains.

AI Alignment: Reframes alignment from permanent value encoding to preserving the ability for consequences to reveal wrong values, models, or strategies. || Evolutionary Systems: Interprets evolution as preserving generative adaptation through environment->selection->variation->new adaptation; seed analogy emphasizes discovery rather than fixed solution. || Scientific Discovery: Maps science to observation->theory->prediction->experiment->revision and claims healthy science preserves Theta_science>0. || Human Cognition: Applies Theta_int to emotions, uncertainty, conflicting beliefs, intuition, and error signals; mature cognition is described as integrating rather than eliminating them. || Shadow Integration: Offers a Jungian interpretation: shadow as causal information excluded from representation; integration restores internal corrigibility. || Organizations: Maps blindness, saturation, stagnation, and drift to institutional failure modes using C, Lambda, Gamma, and Theta. || Education: Frames education as construction of adaptive agents; success reduces dependency while increasing future agency after the teacher disappears. || Artificial Ancestors: Applies deletion test: remove system and measure residual capability; collapse indicates substitution, retained future agency indicates descendants.
Universal Pattern: Claims invariant Reality->Correction->Adaptation->Greater Future Agency across domains.
Final Application Principle: A system is adaptive because what changes it remains capable of changing what it becomes.
Overview: GRA is a constraint layer for adaptive systems, not a definition of intelligence, goals, capabilities, or optimization targets.

System Stack: Source stack: Reality -> Observation -> Representation R -> Reachability Omega -> Correction C -> Adaptation A -> R' -> Future Transformation Capacity; GRA preserves reality->correction->future transformation. || The GRA Constraint: Delta Omega <= C: changes in reachable futures should not exceed correction capacity; Delta Omega > C is described as capable but increasingly detached.

Relationship to Intelligence: Intelligence asks problem-solving effectiveness; GRA asks whether problem-solving remains correctable. || Relationship to Alignment: Alignment is described as an application of GRA; GRA preserves objective corrigibility rather than specifying objectives. || Relationship to Learning: Learning updates models from experience; GRA begins when the transformation/update process itself becomes modifiable. || Relationship to Optimization: Optimization can continue after GRA fails; GRA constrains capability growth by preserved reality authority.

Core Objects / State and Transformation: X_t is state; F is transformation with X_(t+1)=F(X_t). || Core Objects / Transformation Selection: G is the mechanism deciding which transformations survive. || Core Objects / Adaptive Mechanism Space: mathcal G is the set of reachable transformation-selection mechanisms; recursive adaptation occurs when Omega_t -> Delta mathcal G_(t+1).
Failure Boundary: Theta -> 0 marks transition to closed-loop optimization even if optimization, learning, benchmarks, and capability continue.
Summary: GRA is the structural condition allowing a changing system to remain teachable by reality.
Overview: Defines a GRA benchmark for capability growth under preserved corrective authority rather than maximum capability.

Benchmark Objective: Target n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}, recursive depth at which system leaves adaptive domain. || Proxy-Reality Separation: Valid probe requires gradient K parallel gradient P while gradient K not parallel gradient E_real; internal optimization and real consequence disagree.
